An invitation to leave a lasting mark

Your capital. Lasting livelihoods.

The FinMark Trust Impact Endowment invites a small number of South Africans who have built something lasting to help build something that lasts even longer: a permanent, locally-owned source of funding for programmes that turn opportunity into real jobs, incomes, and sustainable livelihoods for people living in poverty.

Why this matters now

Global aid to Africa fell by 23% in 2025 alone — the sharpest single-year drop on record. The institutions doing the hard work of turning opportunity into real, lasting livelihoods can no longer depend on funding from abroad to carry on. The people with the means to change that are the people reading this.

Why an endowment

A gift to the endowment is never spent down. It is invested, permanently, with only the investment income used to fund the work — so a single gift keeps giving, year after year, for as long as the endowment exists. It is the difference between funding one project and funding a lasting pathway out of poverty for the people who need it most.

A named fund in your family's name. A legacy gift through your estate. A founding contribution that helps launch the endowment itself. Whichever form it takes, it becomes a permanent part of how Southern Africa builds sustainable livelihoods for people living in poverty — carrying your name, or your family's, for as long as that work continues.

  • A named fundin your family's name.
  • A legacy giftthrough your estate.
  • A founding contributionthat helps launch the endowment itself.
